title: Medical Records Requests Fee Payment and Transfer to the Patient Financial Account
content:
**Payment.** Where the Medical Records Requests type requires payment before release, the quoted fee is paid before the records are released. Otherwise the fee is invoiced with the release.

**Transfer.** An unpaid fee moves to the patient's financial account only after the request type's transfer period has passed since fulfillment. The period is counted in calendar days starting the day after the fulfillment date, and the transfer may be made only from the day after the last counted day. Where the type's transfer period is 0, no transfer is made; third-party requesters pay before release.

**Effect of a transfer.** Once transferred, the fee becomes a charge in the records-fee line category on the Patient Financial Account, dated the day of the transfer, and follows that account's statement rules. The amount transferred leaves the request's own fee balance.

## The transfer condition, broken down

| Element | Content |
|---|---|
| Clock starts from | Fulfillment, as shown by the fulfillment date on the request record |
| Counting | Calendar days, day 1 being the day after the fulfillment date |
| Earliest transfer day | The day after the last counted day |
| Last counted day itself | Too early (exclusive) |
| Transfer period of 0 | No transfer is ever made |

## Worked dates (hypothetical request with a 30-day transfer period)

- Fulfilled on 5 August. Day 1 is 6 August, so day 30, the last counted day, is 4 September.
- A transfer on 4 September is on the last counted day and is not permitted.
- A transfer on 5 September, the day after the last counted day, is permitted if the fee is still unpaid.

## Payment timing restated

| The type requires payment before release | When the fee is settled |
|---|---|
| Yes | The quoted fee is paid before the records are released |
| No | The fee is invoiced with the release; if it remains unpaid, it may move to the Patient Financial Account once the transfer period has passed, where the type's transfer period is above 0 |

## Basis question

**Is an unpaid fee on a request type whose transfer period is 0 ever moved to the Patient Financial Account?** No. Where the transfer period is 0, no transfer is made.
